subject: music
topicDisplay: Area Of Study 1 Western Classical Music 1600 1910
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.explain: The Baroque period (c1600-1750) came before the Classical period.

questions.q: To which family does the trumpet belong?
questions.explain: The trumpet is a brass instrument.

questions.q: Which composer, deaf in later life, is famous for nine symphonies and bridged the Classical and Romantic eras?
questions.explain: Beethoven wrote nine symphonies and linked the Classical and Romantic periods.

questions.q: A symphony is typically written for which performing force?
questions.explain: A symphony is a large-scale work for full orchestra, usually in several movements.

options: Decorative notes such as trills and mordents added to a melody
The loud ending of a piece
questions.explain: Ornamentation adds decorative notes like trills and mordents to embellish a melody.

questions.q: Romantic music (c1810-1910) is generally noted for:
options: Strong emotional expression and large orchestras
questions.explain: Romantic music emphasises emotion, expression and often larger orchestras.

options: A soloist (or small group) contrasted with an orchestra
questions.explain: A concerto contrasts a soloist or small group with the full orchestra.

questions.q: Roughly which dates define the Classical period?
questions.explain: The Classical period spans roughly 1750 to 1820.

questions.q: Haydn is sometimes called the 'father' of which form?
questions.explain: Haydn helped establish the Classical symphony and string quartet.

questions.q: The 'basso continuo', a continuous bass line often played by harpsichord and cello, is a feature of which period?
questions.explain: The basso continuo is a defining feature of Baroque music.

questions.q: Which composer is most associated with the Baroque period?
questions.explain: J.S. Bach is a leading Baroque composer; Beethoven bridged Classical and Romantic.

questions.q: Which of these is a string instrument of the orchestra?
questions.explain: The cello belongs to the string family; clarinet is woodwind and trumpet is brass.
